patthana24.6:1.1: na hetuṃ na sārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu sārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. tīṇi.
patthana24.6:2.1: na hetuṃ na anārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu anārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. tīṇi. nahetuduka nocittaduke hetuduka cittadukaṃ na hetuṃ no cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu citto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. na hetuṃ na
patthana24.6:4.1: hetu nocitto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nahetuduka nacetasikaduke hetuduka cetasikadukaṃ
patthana24.6:5.1: na hetuṃ na cetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu cetasiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.6:6.1: na hetuṃ na acetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu acetasiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nahetuduka nacittasampayuttaduke hetuduka cittasampayuttadukaṃ
patthana24.6:7.1: na hetuṃ na cittasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu cittasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.6:8.1: na hetuṃ na cittavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu cittavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nahetuduka nocittasaṃsaṭṭhaduke hetuduka cittasaṃsaṭṭhadukaṃ
patthana24.6:9.1: na hetuṃ na cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu cittasaṃsaṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.6:10.1: na hetuṃ na cittavisaṃsaṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu cittavisaṃsaṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nahetuduka nocittasamuṭṭhānaduke hetuduka cittasamuṭṭhānadukaṃ na hetuṃ no cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. na hetuṃ na
patthana24.6:12.1: nocittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nahetuduka nocittasahabhuduke hetuduka cittasahabhudukaṃ na hetuṃ no cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.6:13.1: na hetuṃ na nocittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca
patthana24.6:14.1: nahetu nocittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. tīṇi. nahetuduka nocittānuparivattiduke
patthana24.6:15.1: hetuduka cittānuparivattidukaṃ na hetuṃ no cittānuparivattiṃ
patthana24.6:16.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu nocittānuparivattī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nahetuduka nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaduke hetudu kittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānadukaṃ
patthana24.6:17.1: na hetuṃ no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.6:18.1: na hetuṃ na nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nahetuduka nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuduke hetuduka cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhudukaṃ na hetuṃ no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.6:19.1: na hetuṃ na nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca
patthana24.6:20.1: nahetu nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nahetuduka nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiduke hetuduka cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattidukaṃ na hetuṃ no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.6:21.1: na hetuṃ na nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca
patthana24.6:22.1: nahetu nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nahetuduka naajjhattikaduke hetuduka ajjhattikadukaṃ
patthana24.6:23.1: na hetuṃ na ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.6:24.1: na hetuṃ na bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu bāhiro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nahetuduka naupādāduke hetuduka upādādukaṃ
patthana24.6:25.1: na hetuṃ na upādā dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu upādā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.6:26.1: na hetuṃ na noupādā dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu noupādā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.6:28.1: na hetuṃ na anupādinnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu anupādinno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nahetuduka noupādānagocchakaduke hetuduka upādānagocchakadukaṃ
